baseline.diagnosis: Technically audible but musically crowded: bass, piano, lead, pad, and arp remain active together for most of the form.

constraints: Pad and arp may not be active in the same bar.
Verse and chorus melodies include phrase-ending rest bars.
Bass averages fewer than four notes per bar and rests during opening/closing space.
Piano uses one or two chord attacks per bar with voice leading.
Full six-role density is not used as the default section texture.
